note: A final -ІА is not Ukrainian spelling; names ending in -ia take -ія (Отілія).
A final -ІА is not Ukrainian spelling; the Polish name Basia is Бася in Ukrainian (or БАСІЯ if kept literal).
Настасья is the Russian spelling, while every other name here uses the Ukrainian form; the Ukrainian form is Настасія.
Руфь is the Russian form (Ukrainian never puts ь after ф); the Ukrainian name is Рут, as in EmulatedMind8.
A letter is missing: Asantewaa should be Асантева.
Huygens has the established Ukrainian form Гюйгенс; Гайгенс follows the English pronunciation.
